global_rule: Each project group must name documentation sources, Document RAG sources, plugin test scenarios, and fallback behavior before plugin orchestration coverage can be claimed.
all_prompt_scope: Every row uses ORCHESTRATOR-PROMPT-PLUGIN-EXPECTED-RESULTS-v1.json as the prompt-by-prompt expected-result source. Unsupported prompt/project combinations must return missing-evidence or wrong-scope blocked state, not a fake pass.

rows.business_system_role: Angular client validation target; linked server must be discovered or explicitly marked missing before any full-system claim.
plugin_test_scenarios: detect Angular project scope from active repo
build wiki query plan for UI route/component/service flow
link UI action to API call when evidence exists
return missing linked-server evidence when server root is absent
execute all prompt expected-result rows through Visual Studio and VS Code entrypoints with wrong-scope blocking where needed
missing_source_fallback: If README/design docs are missing, inspect angular.json, package.json, routes, components, services, and generated wiki evidence.
If .xiigen/wiki-domain is missing, generate project-local wiki evidence before plugin prompt probe.
If server evidence cannot be found, block linked Angular/.NET/SQL claim for this project row.
blocked_if_missing: linked server evidence for full-system claims

rows.business_system_role: Linked Angular client and .NET server validation target; SQL evidence must be discovered for stored procedure claims.
plugin_test_scenarios: detect linked Angular + .NET system from active and linked repos
trace UI action to API endpoint to server service
trace persistence and SQL stored procedure evidence when present
answer advanced wiki questions with exact evidence
return missing SQL evidence when stored procedures are absent
missing_source_fallback: If generated wiki evidence is absent, generate it for both roots before probing.
If SQL scripts or stored procedure calls are absent, block stored-procedure-specific claims and continue non-SQL linked-system validation.
If client/server link cannot be proven, block linked-system claim.
blocked_if_missing: client-server route/API evidence for linked-system claim

rows.business_system_role: Linked client/server validation target for cross-repository business flow tracing.
plugin_test_scenarios: detect linked repository group
trace screen/component/service/API flow
trace DTO and persistence impact
validate advanced prompt planning over the linked system
block missing stored-procedure evidence when SQL cannot be found
missing_source_fallback: Generate wiki evidence for both roots if .xiigen output is absent.
Use source routes/controllers/services when documentation is absent.
Block full SQL flow claim until SQL procedure evidence is found.

rows.business_system_role: .NET server validation target; linked client is not assumed unless discovered.
plugin_test_scenarios: detect .NET server scope
trace endpoint to service to persistence
identify SQL stored procedure or missing SQL evidence
return missing linked-client evidence for full Angular/.NET claim
missing_source_fallback: Use solution/project files and server source if docs are absent.
Generate wiki evidence if .xiigen output is absent.
Do not claim Angular + .NET linked system without a linked client root.

rows.business_system_role: Validation target whose stack must be classified from files before probe execution.
plugin_test_scenarios: classify repo stack before selecting scenario expectations
run all prompt rows that match discovered stack
return wrong-scope or missing-evidence blocked state for unsupported prompt rows
record exact stack evidence used for classification
missing_source_fallback: If stack cannot be classified from docs, inspect source file markers.
If generated wiki evidence is absent, generate it before probe.
If neither docs nor source markers identify stack, block with missing evidence.

rows.business_system_role: Validation target whose Angular/.NET role must be classified from files before plugin probes.
plugin_test_scenarios: classify repo stack before selecting scenario expectations
run prompt rows for discovered stack
block unsupported full-system claims with missing linked evidence
record documentation/RAG/source evidence used for the answer
missing_source_fallback: If docs are absent, inspect source markers.
If .xiigen outputs are absent, generate wiki evidence first.
If stack remains unknown, block with missing evidence.

rows.business_system_role: Translated full-stack XIIGen validation target for plugin orchestration scenarios.
plugin_test_scenarios: run every orchestrator prompt expected-result row against translated flows scope
verify plugin passes active repo scope to XIIGen
verify query plan, selected units, evidence checks, and blocked states
verify no plugin-local semantic routing
missing_source_fallback: Generate wiki evidence if absent.
Use source and project metadata when docs are absent.
Block any flow claim whose evidence cannot be found in source or generated wiki outputs.

rows.business_system_role: Translated full-stack XIIGen platform validation target for plugin orchestration scenarios.
plugin_test_scenarios: run every orchestrator prompt expected-result row against translated platform scope
verify plugin passes active repo scope to XIIGen
verify query plan, selected units, evidence checks, and blocked states
verify no plugin-local semantic routing
missing_source_fallback: Generate wiki evidence if absent.
Use source and project metadata when docs are absent.
Block any platform claim whose evidence cannot be found in source or generated wiki outputs.
